verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack states an AI-training policy or opt-out. Temporal does document two indirect controls: self-hosting the Temporal Service on your own infrastructure, and Payload Codecs/Codec Server encryption to protect sensitive Workflow data, so the service only handles encrypted payloads. Together these technically keep workflow data from being exposed to the vendor. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training commitment or opt-out setting for Temporal Cloud, data-usage/privacy policy documentation, and independent corroboration.
